verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires four editable report-template variants selected according to customer score and risk level.
The client explicitly establishes the exposure-level title mapped to each RR01–RR04 template; no prior attribute conflicts with this added mapping.
First concrete failure: review showed RR02, RR03, and RR04 displaying the incorrect Severe Exposure title.
Post-failure implementation claim; the tightly bounded preceding request explicitly enumerates the report-band title corrections included in everything claimed completed.
First concrete post-claim verification: the client confirms the main report-band corrections were completed and the corrected front-page titles were reviewed.
